purpose: Portable consultancy methodology for building durable, dependency-aware, AI-enabled organizational operating systems.
next_action: Build the consultancy kickoff and discovery kit: executive sponsor interview guide, current-state authority discovery, working-plane inventory, durable-state assessment, process/change pain-point discovery, AI/agent readiness assessment, confidentiality/access boundary checklist, and an engagement discovery output contract that feeds a client control-plane bootstrap without assuming Tenshodo-specific structure.
principles: Conversation is an execution surface, not the durable record.
Durable operational state must survive employee, tool, consultant, and conversation turnover.
Working planes and durable control planes have different jobs.
One information class should have one declared authority at a time.
Target accountability and current execution authority are separate.
AI may incubate functions without inheriting human organizational authority.
Consequential proposals and adopted decisions are different states.
A role-conversation launch prompt is a bootstrap pointer; live durable state and declared authoritative systems override it.
Local improvement should create global awareness without automatic global change.
Client confidentiality and portability are architectural requirements, not cleanup tasks.
